import zipfile

SRC = DST = 'sales_data.xlsx'
z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
items = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
z.close()

sheet = items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = items['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# --- sheet1.xml: dimension, column width, header, formulas ---
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"')
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>')
for r in range(2, 10):
    g = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    sheet = sheet.replace(g, g + f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>')
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>',
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
    '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>')

# --- styles.xml: add 0.0% number format (id 165) and cellXf s=3 ---
styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
                        '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="165" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">')
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
                        '<xf numFmtId="165" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>')

items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
items['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for name, data in items.items():
        out.writestr(name, data)

print('written OK')

import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
bad = z.testzip()
print('zip integrity:', 'OK' if bad is None else f'BAD: {bad}')

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
styles = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))

# 1. dimension
print('dimension:', sheet.find('m:dimension', ns).attrib['ref'])

# 2. headers
hdr = {c.attrib['r']: ''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
       for c in sheet.find('m:sheetData', ns).find('m:row', ns).findall('m:c', ns)}
print('headers:', hdr)

# 3. all cells in rows 2-10 with their formulas
for row in sheet.find('m:sheetData', ns).findall('m:row'):
    r = row.attrib['r']
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        f = c.find('m:f', ns)
        cells.append((c.attrib['r'], c.attrib.get('s',''), f.text if f is not None else ''))
    print('row', r, cells)

# 4. styles: numFmt 165 and cellXfs count
nf = styles.find('m:numFmts', ns)
print('numFmts count:', nf.attrib['count'], '->', [(x.attrib['numFmtId'], x.attrib['formatCode']) for x in nf])
xfs = styles.find('m:cellXfs', ns)
print('cellXfs count:', xfs.attrib['count'])

# 5. expected profit margins (computed from raw inputs)
print('\nExpected margins:')
for r in range(2, 10):
    units = int(sheet.find('m:sheetData', ns).find(f'm:row[@r="{r}"]/m:c[@r="C{r}"]/m:v', ns).text)
    price = int(sheet.find('m:sheetData', ns).find(f'm:row[@r="{r}"]/m:c[@r="D{r}"]/m:v', ns).text)
    cost = int(sheet.find('m:sheetData', ns).find(f'm:row[@r="{r}"]/m:c[@r="F{r}"]/m:v', ns).text)
    rev, prof = units*price, units*(price-cost)
    print(f'  row {r}: profit={prof}, revenue={rev}, margin={prof/rev:.4f} = {prof/rev:.1%}')
z.close()
